content: ![農民的莊稼](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f6ca361149dfce02aeb956a781dfd1d0c079704.png) 此模組為 Minecraft 增添了更多莊稼與灌木 ![Screenshot 2024-12-22 183954](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d0d27c25-ed6f-409c-9bea-389e9b5d2a32) 新增的灌木包括草莓、藍莓與黑莓（這些會自然生成）。 新增的莊稼則是帶有種子的玉米與番茄。 番茄種子 ![Screenshot 2024-12-22 183825](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/07d2deb1-05f6-484b-b56d-de504bd14056) 玉米粒 ![Screenshot 2024-12-22 183840](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b9d048d3-5773-426b-ae84-f1888a0e75e5) 玉米粒可熔煉成玉米棒 黑莓派 ![Screenshot 2024-12-22 184025](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/176fff27-16fa-45e1-99f8-e271f6c1fca2) 新增一種名為「糕點機」的方塊，可將藍莓轉化為瑪芬蛋糕 ![Screenshot 2024-12-22 181416](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/48404baf-8bbf-4961-9bce-57014ce3b792) ![Screenshot 2024-12-22 185152](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ce1ddf81-4dc2-4501-b08d-f4d4f0032a1a) 草莓檸檬汁 ![Screenshot 2024-12-22 185111](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/79505056-d55f-49c9-bbb1-17233223959d) ## 祝您遊玩愉快！
